title: Promise-Echo Advocate
text: Promise-Echo Advocate summons the remembered weight of every broken bargain and argues that the road itself is owed. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It never raises its voice. The debt does that for it.

defeatReward.text: Promise-Echo Advocate is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
